lines: Mitsuki
「Nasty rain. Feels like even my mind's going to get damp.」
Mitsuki grumbled gloomily.
She idly looked up to the sky, wondering when this damp, heavy rain would stop.
However, Mitsuki was in Yomihara, 300 metres below Tokyo.
All she could see was a ceiling―――or rather, the bottoms of buildings, sticking out haphazardly.
Furthermore, countless power lines, communications cables, water pipes and gas pipes, which were stealing from aboveground, were tangled together chaotically,
And it felt as though she were being shown the innards of a gigantic living creature purporting to be a city.
Even this rain was water leakage, rain that had fallen to the earth's surface and permeated this far down over the years, and it smelled like rusted iron.
When she breathed a sigh and shifted her eyes to the cityscape, every building was adorned with the kind of sleazy neon that hurt her eyes.
Shady-looking goods were lined up in stalls, and only disreputable-looking people came and went. It was the very model of a city of criminals.
Mitsuki
「Sanada-senpai was sold to a town like this......」
She thought of her extrication target for this mission, her senpai at Gosha Academy.
Sanada Homura.
She was the Taimanin's foremost Fire Escape user.
She had thrown herself into combat for a long time, waging numerous battles with demons, and her ability was well-established.
However, her reputation among her fellow Taimanin was by no means a good one.
Supposedly, she was extremely hotheaded, and didn't think about anything but fighting.
A battle freak, they said. A Taimanin in name only.
Mitsuki had never shared a mission with her before, but as far as she could recall, she certainly seemed that way.
When Mitsuki was still at Gosha Academy, there had been a few times when Homura had shown up out of nowhere by herself.
She didn't come to see anyone, or whatnot. In between missions, she would show up to fight anybody whatsoever, purportedly as special training intended to kill time.
She was feared by most of the students, as she didn't care whether her opponent was a teacher or pupil, and what was more, didn't hold back at all.
Mitsuki, who had been Class President in those days, had also been forced to take her on at times.
As she recalled, Homura's fighting style, which combined Fire Escape with a long spear, was, in a word, superb,
And she had looked to be quite pleased with Mitsuki, who had countered that with her Wind Escape. But to be frank, it was not a happy memory.
Mitsuki
「I can't believe the Sonada-senpai got captured......」
Mitsuki breathed a sigh.
She had been told that Homura had gone missing during a mission.
The full details of that were unclear, but from what that slave trader named Bosluk told her, he had obtained her from a passing slave trader, whose name he didn't know.
Apparently, at that time, Homura had had her Fire Escape powers neutralized.
If not for that, there was no way that she would have been sold as merchandise without a fight.
Even so, knowing that Homura was a Taimanin, Bosluk had been at a loss for how to handle her, and had sent her straight off to a slave auction.
She had been bought by an organization here in Yomihara called “Tsuchigumo”, and beyond that, her whereabouts were unknown.
Mitsuki
「Sanada-senpai, I hope you're safe......」
She may not have been a senpai Mitsuki liked too much, but that was a different matter.
She had to rescue her, whatever it took.
To that end, Mitsuki had arranged to meet up with a comrade here, but they hadn't shown yet.
The rain was still continuing to fall.
It even seemed like it was never, ever going to stop.
Mitsuki
「I want to have some hot black tea. Assam, with lots of milk and sugar in it...」
She was idly grumbling things like that, and shivering from the cold, when
「This rain is awfully gloomy, don't you think?」
All of a sudden, someone had thrown their arms around her from behind.
Mitsuki
「Hyaah!」
She may have been turning a few things over in her head, but this place was enemy territory. It wasn't like she hadn't been paying attention.
So startled that she thought her heart would stop, she made a squeak that was unbecoming of a Taimanin, and there, right up close, was a familiar face.
Mitsuki
「K-Kousaka-sensei?!」
Shizuru
「Sorry. Have I kept you waiting?」
Shizuru said, still wrapping her arms around Mitsuki.
The bulges of her voluptuous breasts, which were the same as the old days, were pressing firmly into Mitsuki's back.
Mitsuki
「N-No, I only just arrived.」
Shizuru
「A total lie. Your body's gotten so chilly... Say, why don't we warm each other up somewhere?」
Mitsuki
「Eh?」
Shizuru
「I've missed you, Mitsuki...」
Shizuru whispered in a sensual voice, calling her by her given name, and holding her tighter still.
The sweet scent of roses gently tickled Mitsuki's nose.
Despite being a fellow woman, it got her heart pounding a little, yet she calmly replied,
Mitsuki
「Kousaka-sensei, please stop making those jokes already.」
Shizuru
「Ahaha, I knew you wouldn't fall for it anymore.」
Shizuru laughed, as she simply moved her body away.
Her air was like that of an ex-girlfriend who hadn't seen her for a long time, but obviously they didn't have that kind of relationship―――and, it disappeared in an instant.
Mitsuki
「That's because, back in my student days, you did it to me loads of times. Are you still getting excessively physical like that with your students?」
Shizuru replied to Mitsuki's dig with a nonchalant expression.
Shizuru
「From time to time. Using your womanly weapons, and having them used by others, are necessary skills for a Taimanin. Is that still a weak point for Hoshino-san?」
Mitsuki
「I do it if I need to. But I don't like it.」
Shizuru unintentionally let out a giggle at Mitsuki, who answered deadly seriously.
Shizuru
「Same as ever, eh? Still, I'm glad you're looking well.」
Mitsuki
「Same. It's been a long time, Kousaka-sensei.」
Mitsuki bowed her head deeply.
Shizuru
「You don't have to call me Sensei anymore.」
Mitsuki
「No, to me, Sensei is Sensei.」
Shizuru
「That dead seriousness... You haven't changed, eh?」
The eyes of Shizuru, who gazed at Mitsuki, became those looking at a former pupil.
For Mitsuki, this was a reunion with an old mentor.
Shizuru
「Good work, Hoshino-san. Thanks to you, I've been able to obtain Sanada-san's whereabouts.」
Mitsuki
「Is Sanada-senpai safe?」
Shizuru
「Perhaps, for the moment.」
Mitsuki
Shizuru
「For now, let's go to my safehouse. There's another girl waiting for you that you haven't seen for a while.」
Mitsuki
「Eh? Who is it?」
Shizuru
「You'll see when you meet her♪」
Shizuru said with an impish expression, like back in the old days, when she had some kind of surprise in class.
The safehouse was a bar in a Yomihara back street.
The one waiting for Mitsuki certainly was someone she hadn't seen for a long time, but not someone she had expected.
Mutsuho
「Yo, Prez.」
Mitsuki
「Yanagi-san?」
Yanagi Mutsuho stood up from her stool and casually raised her hand.
She hadn't thrown her arms around her, like Shizuru, but in a sense, Mitsuki was more surprised than when that happened.
Mutsuho
「Long time no see. Since graduation, was it?」
Mitsuki
「That's right. It's been a while.」
Mutsuho
「The name of the “Fan Storm Taimanin” has been making waves. Just like I'd expect from the President.」
While feeling a strange embarrassment about being called “President”, like the old days, she replied,
Mitsuki
「Come on, I should be the one saying that about Yanagi-san. I hear you've succeeded at lots of solo missions. Well done.」
Mutsuho
「Well, maybe a few.」
Mutsuho shrugged, not being boastful or humble, but like she just didn't care.
That hard-to-grasp demeanour was no different at all from the old days.
Mitsuki and Mutsuho had been classmates at Gosha Academy.
That was the most accurate description.
Because in their student days, they had never been too close.
Being one of the elite from a family of poison users, Mutsuho was feared by other students because of that ability,
And she herself had looked somewhat like she was avoiding other people, so she was always on her own.
Mitsuki had wanted to make friends with Mutsuho, but when she invited her to study or play, she was often rejected,
And even though on rare occasions she would accept, Mutsuho would constantly make an uninterested-looking face, and Mitsuki started to feel bad about forcing her to go along with her.
She had heard that, even after graduating from school, Mutsuho never teamed up with anyone, and only did solo missions.
Perhaps because those thoughts had shown on her face, Mutsuho was gazing fixedly at Mitsuki.
Mutsuho
「Your face is saying you're surprised to be with me, 'cuz I'm always on my own, eh, President?」
Mitsuki
「N-No, not at all. I'm pleased to be working with you, Yanagi-san.」
Mutsuho
「The pleasure's all mine.」
Shizuru
「As I recall, weren't the two of you paired up in the school's doubles skills tournament?」
Shizuru, who had brought Mitsuki here, said as if she had suddenly remembered that.
Mitsuki
「Umm...... Yes, that's right......」
Mitsuki nodded uncertainly, and Mutsuho frowned a little.
Mutsuho
「Shizuru-sensei, you're reminding us of some unpleasant stuff all of a sudden.」
Mutsuho
「We won our match, but we couldn't do the combination play at all, so we got disqualified. Right, President?」
Mitsuki
Thinking back on it now, that tournament might have been an opportunity to become closer friends with Mutsuho.
As she said, it had ended in disaster, though.
Shizuru
「Oh, was that a fact? Then, please do better this time, okay?」
Mutsuho
「That's easy for you to say. Well, I'll try.」
Mitsuki
「......I'll do my best.」
Mitsuki could only answer with that, but on the inside, she had grown a little uneasy.
Like in their student days, Mutsuho seemed amiable on the face of her, but she couldn't tell what she was thinking very well.
Shizuru
「Now then, since we're all accounted for, I'll explain the present situation, shall I?」
Shizuru
「First, with regards to “Tsuchigumo”, the enemy that appear to be holding Sanada-san captive.」
Shizuru
「They control a section of Yomihara, and are hostile to Nomad, being in alliance with Ryuumon, a Chinese Union-affiliated organization.」
Shizuru
「The organization is moderate in scale, but it looks like their boss, Katsuragi, the “Lady of the Spiders”, is a high-ranking demon.」
Mitsuki
「High-ranking demon......」
Mutsuho
「Lady of the... She's got an overblown nickname, too.」
Shizuru
「Indeed. But she's rumoured to be a powerful being, rivalling even senior executives from Nomad.」
Shizuru
「As her name suggests, it's said that she has spider abilities, and absorbs the life essence of humans and demons to maintain her power and beauty.」
Shizuru
「If we don't rescue Sanada-san quickly, then even if she is alive, she'll have her life energy sucked out, and end up an invalid.」
Mitsuki
Mutsuho
「―――So, what kinda plan are we going with? You've already thought of one, haven't you, Shizuru-sensei?」
Shizuru nodded at Mutsuho's question.
Shizuru
「In addition to us, there's another unit who have already infiltrated Yomihara, and are on standby in a different safe house.」
Mitsuki
「There's another unit?」
Shizuru
「The Independent Commando Unit everyone's talking about these days. I've arranged for them to make a frontal assault, to create a diversion.」
Shizuru
「The plan is to take that opportunity to sneak into the Tsuchigumo base through a back entrance I've discovered, and rescue Sanada-san.」
Mutsuho
「What do we do about Ms. Whatever of the Spiders? Better dispose of her, I guess?」
Shizuru
「Her strength is unknown. If the rumours are true, combat is to be avoided, don't you think?」
Mitsuki
「......You're right. Here, the whole city is like enemy territory. I doubt we'll have time to be fighting at our leisure.」
Shizuru
「I suppose not.」
Looking askance at Mitsuki, who agreed with Shizuru's plan, Mutsuho made a fed-up-looking face.
Mutsuho
「As ever, that battle nut's a nuisance to everyone.」
Mutsuho
「It'd be one thing if she'd died on her own, but to get taken prisoner by an enemy! It would be easier if she just killed herself or something, and yet...」
Mitsuki
「Yanagi-san, it's not nice to talk like that.」
Come to think of it, Mitsuki recalled her being the kind of person who spat venom like this.
Mutsuho
「What are you saying? She's given the Prez trouble too, right?」
Mutsuho
「I ran away, but the President diligently went along with that girl's antics, didn't she?」
Mitsuki
「That may be true, but...... Still, she's a fellow Taimanin, so I have to help her.」
Mutsuho
「Prez's serious as ever, eh? I don't care about that moron, but that's the mission, right? I'm with you.」
Shizuru burst into laughter at the unenthused-sounding Mutsuho.
Shizuru
「Ufufu, Yanagi-san is worried about Fuuma-kun, isn't she?」
Mutsuho
「Wha? It's not like that!」
Mutsuho immediately denied.
Mitsuki
「Fuuma-kun? Is that the Independent Commando Unit's―――」
Shizuru
「Commander. He teamed up with Yanagi-san a little while ago.」
After glancing at Mutsuho suggestively, Shizuru said
Shizuru
「Oh, I see...... A prospective boyfriend for Yanagi-san, perhaps?」
Mutsuho
「I'm telling you, that's wrong! Shizuru-sensei, I won't forgive you if you say anything too weird!」
Mutsuho had gotten worked up and snapped at her.
Mitsuki had never seen her act like that even once in their student days.
She was a tad surprised.
Fuuma Kotarou of the Independent Commando Unit.
He was the head of the Fuuma family―――the ones who hadn't joined in on the insurrection that one Fuuma sect had caused in Gosha Village a short time ago.
She had also heard that he couldn't use Ninja Arts at all. He seemed like an odd person.
Shizuru was teasing and messing with Mutsuho for a while, but then suddenly went back to a serious expression and said,
Shizuru
「I'll be serving as backup for Fuuma-kun and his friends, so you infiltrate the base and rescue Sanada-san yourselves, please.」
Mitsuki
「Eh? Isn't Kousaka-sensei going to be giving us orders?」
Mitsuki, who had been assuming that Shizuru would be their commander, asked back in surprise.
Shizuru
「Knowing you guys, I'm sure you'll be fine. I leave it in your hands. Hoshino-san will be unit leader, all right?」
Mitsuki
「Eh? B-But...??」
Mutsuho
「Fine with me.」
Out of nowhere, Shizuru had named Mitsuki the commander, and Mutsuho had readily agreed to that.
Mitsuki was nothing short of flummoxed.
Mitsuki
「But, Yanagi-san, this will be my first experience being the leader on a real mission, so I'm not that sure of mys―――」
Mutsuho
「Even if you say that, it's just the two of us, and it's not like we've never met before. You'll manage.」
Mitsuki
「Still, I'm sure Yanagi-san knows this, but I tend to blow it at the last minute......」
Mutsuho
「Ah, now that you mention it, you did often get told that by people like Sakura-sensei.」
Mutsuho
「But I'm not the leader type, so I'll defer to the Prez.」
Mitsuki
She was simply bewildered by this unexpected event.
「Hoshino! What's with that attitude?!! You call yourself a Taimanin?!!」
Mitsuki
「Y-Yes!! I apologize, Uehara-sensei!!」
After responding almost reflexively to a sudden angry shout,
Mitsuki
「Eh? Uehara-sensei?」
She looked in surprise in the direction the voice came from, and a figure emerged from the shadows.
Rin
「Honestly. You're the same as ever.」
Mitsuki
「Long time no see!」
Her spine had reflexively straightened up.
The Electric Glow Taimanin, Uehara Rin.
Someone who had trained Mitsuki hard and extensively, as a special instructor at Gosha Academy, an oni-like teacher specializing in open-air combat.
Mutsuho
「Maaannn～～, here comes a pain in the ass.」
Mutsuho went out of her way to say something that didn't have to be said.
Rin
「I see you haven't changed either, Yanagi.」
Mutsuho
「People don't change that much, Sensei.」
Despite being glared at by Rin's scary eyes, Mutsuho had a blasé air to her. It had been this way since the old days.
Shizuru
「I forgot to mention, I'm going to have Uehara-sensei go with you two, in a support capacity.」
Shizuru said, as though she had only just remembered. She had been deliberately keeping it secret until now.
Mitsuki
「Eh? Really?」
Mitsuki suddenly made her face light up, but
Rin
「Moron. Don't be happy! I had no intention of showing myself if you two looked like you could do this right!」
Mitsuki
「I'm sorry!」
Once she was yelled at in that voice, she reflexively ducked her head down, as though she had gone back to her student days.
Shizuru
「Ufufu, then you were planning to back these two up in secret, were you, Uehara-sensei?」
Rin
「Kousaka, don't say anything you don't have to.」
Rin warned sharply.
Shizuru covered her mouth with her hand, making a face that said, 「Ah, I let it slip!」
Rin looked dead straight at Mitsuki and Mutsuho.
Rin
「Listen up, you lot. I am only your support.」
Rin
「I am not going to be commanding you. The team leader is you, Hoshino.」
Rin
「I appointed you because I thought you could handle it. Got that?」
Mitsuki
「Y-Yes!」
Still a little unsure, Mitsuki nodded firmly, trying to light a fire under herself.
And so it came to pass that a three-man team was formed, with Mutsuho and Rin, and Mitsuki as the leader.
Shizuru
「I think you'll do well. Now, shall I tell you about our secret weapon? Well, just in case, of course.」
Shizuru cut in, and a more detailed briefing began.
A few hours later, the trio of Mitsuki, Mutsuho and Rin were creeping through the Yomihara sewers.
According to Shizuru's investigation, they would be able to infiltrate the Tsuchigumo base from these sewers, so they had received a detailed map leading there.
Taking the vanguard was Mitsuki, with Mutsuho right behind her.
Being in a support role, Rin was following at a short distance from the pair.
These were sewers even deeper down than Yomihara, where water leaking from aboveground fell down as rain.
Their filthiness was easy to imagine, and furthermore, because they were full of forks and tributaries and so forth, it felt like the party were going to get lost, even with a map.
Mitsuki
「Haaahhh......」
Mitsuki idly breathed a sigh, at which point, perhaps because she was in a similar frame of mind, Mutsuho started a conversation.
Mutsuho
「That's a horrible smell. Your nose okay, Prez?」
Mitsuki
「I'm fine.」
Mitsuki answered, but her nose had been going crazy for quite a while.
Mutsuho
「My senses have gone haywire. We've been put to some serious trouble, thanks to our idiot senpai.」
Mitsuki
「Yanagi-san.」
Mutsuho
「Yeah, yeah, I know. I won't say it again.」
Mutsuho shrugged her shoulders, making a face which said, 「The Prez is sure serious, huh?」
Mitsuki lowered her voice and rephrased her rebuke.
Mitsuki
「No, it's not that. Supposedly, there are demonic monsters lurking in these underground tunnels, so we had better be as quiet as we can.」
Mutsuho
「Huh? There are monsters?」
Mitsuki
「That was written in the report from a squad who passed through here before.」
Mitsuki
「Apparently they were attacked by Hell Wasps and Devil Worms.」
Mutsuho
「That's the President for ya. You do all your homework, don't you?」
Mitsuki
「No, that's not what―――Ah.」
Mitsuki was about to act modest, but suddenly stopped upon realizing something.
Mutsuho
「What's wrong? Did you sense the presence of those things with your wind?」
Mutsuho approached her and asked.
Mitsuki
「No, I just remembered. That squad was the Independent Commando Unit, where Yanagi-san's friend is......」
Mutsuho
「Eh? I see. Hmmm.」
Saying that alone, Mutsuho began to walk briskly ahead.
Mitsuki's interest was piqued a little by that clearly unnatural behaviour, and she quickly moved in alongside her.
Mitsuki
「Yanagi-san, what kind of person is Fuuma-san?」
Mutsuho
「Wh-What kind of...? That guy is nothing to me!」
Despite her having broached the subject more or less casually, Mutsuho had suddenly answered that back in a firm tone.
Mitsuki
「Eh?」
Mutsuho
「What?!」
Mitsuki
「No, I just wondered what kind of person he is. He's the head of his clan, yet he didn't join in on the Fuuma rebellion.」
She couldn't help but break into a smile.
Mitsuki
「I didn't particularly ask about his relationship with Yanagi-san...... Ufufu.」
Mutsuho
Mutsuho turned her face away embarrassedly.
Mitsuki cut around on that side, to say, “It's no use, I'm not letting you get away.”
Mitsuki
「Eh? So is that the kind of person Fuuma-san is to Yanagi-san? Maybe something, maybe nothing?」
Mutsuho
「I-I didn't say he meant anything to me! What are you talking about, President?!」
Mutsuho was extremely agitated. Mitsuki had never seen her like this.
Mitsuki
「Wow, wow! I can barely believe it, considering the old Yanagi-san!!」
Mitsuki
「I wonder what kind of person Fuuma-san is. You've got me curious!!」
Mutsuho
「He's not any kind of person! Prez, cut it out with your weird suspicions!」
Mitsuki
「But, for Yanagi-san to like him, he must be really something, right? And he's younger than you! Younger!!」
Mutsuho
「I-I didn't say a word about liking him! And I don't care if he's younger than me!」
Mitsuki
「Ehhh～～? But, but, the fact that Yanagi-san's reacting that way must mean―――」
Mutsuho
「Must mean what?! Cut it out, Preside―――」
Mitsuki
「Ouch!」
Mutsuho
「Ow!」
A clenched fist had suddenly struck their heads.
Both of them.
They held their heads in their hands side-by-side.
It was the doing of Uehara Rin, who had approached without them realizing it.
Rin
「Do you think you're here on a field trip or something?」
Merciless blows. Just the way it used to be.
Mitsuki
「I'm sorry!」
Mutsuho
「Been a long time since I was on the receiving end of that fist.」
Perhaps because they had been caught off guard, Mutsuho made teary eyes, and looked at Mitsuki a little reproachfully.
Mitsuki
「I apologize, Yanagi-san. As we're on a mission right now, I'll go without the unnecessary chitchat.」
Mutsuho
「I sure hope so.」
Rin
「Too late. Monsters have heard the commotion and come this way.」
Mitsuki
「Eh?」
Mutsuho
「Ah, she's right!」
A buzzing sound could be heard from far in the distance.
Mixed in with that, there was also the sound of something enormous slithering along.
Rin
「Fuuh...... This doesn't bode well.」
Rin muttered, with a sigh, and the next moment, the owners of those sounds appeared from the depths of the sewers.
Hell Wasp
Devil Worm
「GRUUUUUUUUUU!!!!!」
Hell Wasps and a Devil Worm.
They were demonic monsters, just like in the report.
